BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: warding
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: In a fight, something about it turns blows aside from its pack. It and friendly people and animals within 6 tiles that it can see take 15% less damage.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: shields those who fight beside it

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: mending presence
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: Wounds close faster near it. It and friendly people and animals within 5 tiles that it can see heal 75% faster, downed or not.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: makes the wounds of those around it close by themselves

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: snaring
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: Something about it drags at the legs of its enemies. Living enemies within 5 tiles that it can see move 25% slower.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: slows anyone who tries to run from it
